assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, heritage controls, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The proposal can be reviewed as an AI-generated formal intake package; statutory controls and professional scoring need official files and recalculation.

assumptions.statement: Submitted site and key-area polygons are derived from repository provisional boundaries.
assumptions.impact: All areas, drawings, and diagrams must be recalculated when official polygons are supplied.

assumptions.statement: AI events, developer-community operation, scenario opening, and public routes are concept suggestions.
assumptions.impact: They do not represent confirmed government programs, investment, procurement, or construction schedules.

assumptions.statement: Figures and PDFs are generated from local geometry, metrics, matrices, and original schematic drawing; no remote images, map tiles, fonts, trademarks, portraits, or corporate marks are embedded.
assumptions.impact: Future branded visual identity work must clear fonts, icons, logos, and case-study images separately.
